name: XCF Global, Inc.

profile.description: XCF Global develops sustainable aviation fuel (SAF) and renewable diesel production, operating the New Rise Renewables facility in Reno, Nevada, which restarted in July 2026. H1 2026 revenue was $1.04M versus $6.58M in H1 2025, with a Q2 2026 net loss of $14.1M and a going-concern warning [1].

innovation.label: WEAK
innovation.analysis: Track Record (1/3): restarted the Reno SAF/renewable diesel facility in July 2026 and posted over $10M of August revenue [1]. AI Deployment (0/2): none evident. Market Share (0/2): early-stage entrant with no share data. Pipeline (1/2): 2027 targets of $110-120M net revenue tied to reaching full SAF capacity, but unproven [1]. R&D (0/1): none reported.

inspiration.label: WEAK
inspiration.analysis: Mission Floor (2/4): clear mission to decarbonize aviation with SAF, but not distinctive and not yet validated by execution [1]. Community (0/2): no programs found. Retention (0/2): no data. Insider Buying (0/2): no net insider buying found; shares trade at $0.33 after heavy dilution.

infrastructure.label: WEAK
infrastructure.analysis: Mechanically scored as Growth: D/E of 690.7% (0), ROE of -246% (0, 2x), revenue growth of -89.5% (0), negative forward P/E (0), zero profit margin (0). Weighted score 0. Daily dollar volume of about $1.28M just clears the $1M liquidity floor, but the stock is near it and below $1 [1].

ai_resilience.label: LOW RISK
ai_resilience.analysis: AI Risk Protection (8/9): SAF and renewable diesel production is physical-world, regulated infrastructure that AI cannot substitute, and no analyst flags AI disruption for the business. AI Opportunity (0/1): no AI revenue. The score reflects AI immunity only, not financial viability, which is addressed by Infrastructure.

infinite_game.summary: XCF has a worthwhile decarbonization purpose, but its survival depends on financing and a single restarted facility, with a going-concern warning and revenue collapse. There is no track record yet of holding its cause through hardship.

just_cause.analysis: Just Cause (1/3): decarbonizing aviation is a meaningful aim, but the company is too new to show consistency through crises [1].

trusting_teams.analysis: Trusting Teams (0/2): no culture data; going-concern pressure and a de-SPAC history suggest instability.

worthy_rivals.analysis: Worthy Rivals (0/1): no evidence of rival-oriented learning.

existential_flexibility.analysis: Existential Flexibility (1/2): moved from a SPAC shell to an operating fuels producer, restarting a facility, but this is early-stage formation rather than reinvention.

courage_to_lead.analysis: Courage to Lead (0/2): no evidence of costly principled decisions; dilution and financing pressure dominate.

investment_thesis: XCF at $0.33 is a speculative SAF pure play with the Reno facility restarted in July 2026, over $10M of August revenue on 1.3 million gallons of renewable diesel, and management targets of $110-120M net revenue in 2027 [1]. Policy tailwinds and airline demand for SAF offer upside if full capacity is reached.
thesis_continued: The bear case is solvency: Q2 2026 net loss of $14.1M on $0.69M revenue, H1 revenue down 84% YoY, D/E of 690.7%, ROE of -246%, and a going-concern warning after a $32M loss [1]. The stock is below $1, has traded under its 50-day average of $0.40, and dilution or delisting risk is high.
key_catalysts: Ramp of New Rise Reno toward full SAF capacity beyond $10M monthly revenue [1]
Financing that resolves going-concern doubt and funds working capital [1]
Execution toward the 2027 net revenue target of $110-120M [1]
key_risks: Going-concern warning and cash burn with D/E of 690.7% [1]
Sub-$1 share price creating Nasdaq compliance and dilution risk [1]
Dependence on one facility and on SAF pricing and incentive policy [1]
